slides.texte_overlay:
strange mind tricks that
work on almost everyone

the curious pause

when someone finishes talking, wait two seconds before you reply. people very often fill the silence with the most honest part of what they wanted to say.

the small favour

ask someone for a tiny favour, like borrowing a pen. people tend to like you more after they've helped you, because their brain quietly decides you must be worth the effort.

the side by side talk

have difficult conversations while walking side by side, not face to face at a table. moving together makes people more relaxed and much more open with you.

the surprising fact

share one surprising fact in a conversation and people remember you for days afterwards. 5 minutes a day learning something unexpected keeps you full of them.
slides.texte_sophia:
the surprising fact

learn one surprising fact a day, like why the moon looks bigger near the horizon. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and people remember whoever surprised them.

slides.texte_overlay:
the open palms

show your palms when you explain something. open hands look honest and relaxed, and people instinctively trust what you say a little more when they can see them.
